items.title: Mikey Madison plays a Facebook whistleblower in 'The Social Reckoning.' Here's where the real Frances Haugen is now.
items.summary: Mikey Madison stars in "The Social Reckoning" as Frances Haugen, the real-life whistleblower who sparked a Facebook scandal. Here's what she's doing today.
items.titleZh: Mikey Madison在《社会清算》中扮演一名脸书告密者。“这就是真正的弗朗西斯·豪根现在所在的地方。
items.summaryZh: Mikey Madison在《社会清算》中饰演弗朗西斯·豪根，她是引发脸书丑闻的真实告密者。这是她今天要做的事。

items.title: Jev, an AI for making quick decisions, has been a viral hit in Silicon Valley. But OpenAI is hot on its heels
items.summary: After helping develop ChatGPT, TypeSafe CEO Diogo Almeida spent two years building Jev, which went viral with developers. His former employer is now racing to catch up.
items.titleZh: Jev是一款能够快速做出决策的人工智能，在硅谷大受欢迎。但OpenAI紧随其后
items.summaryZh: 在帮助开发ChatGPT之后，TypeSafe首席执行官Diogo Almeida花了两年时间构建了Jev，它在开发人员中迅速传播开来。他的前雇主现在正争先恐后地追赶。

items.titleZh: SAP的Sean Kask：软件公司必须成为人工智能公司，否则就会灭亡
items.summaryZh: SAP首席人工智能战略官Sean Kask表示，成熟的软件公司必须围绕人工智能重建其产品，而不是将其作为另一个功能添加。周四，他在都灵的Wave by Vento发表了讲话。“就像那句著名的俏皮话，每家公司都在成为一家软件公司…

items.title: Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky says he wishes he were 26 again because the opportunities post-ChatGPT ‘are so much more powerful’
items.summary: Brian Chesky, the cofounder of $95.8 billion Airbnb, says now all it takes is a handful of people to start a company—that “was inconceivable before” AI.
items.titleZh: Airbnb首席执行官布莱恩·切斯基表示，他希望自己能再次回到26岁，因为ChatGPT之后的机会“更加强大”
items.summaryZh: 价值958亿美元的Airbnb联合创始人Brian Chesky表示，现在只需要少数人就可以创办一家公司——这在人工智能之前是“不可想象的”。
